cfg_invariant: During SwitchMLP construction, the router's weight init must execute inside a get_cuda_rng_tracker().fork(<data-parallel name>) context
cfg_root_cause: Buggy init does `self.router = torch.nn.Linear(...)` outside of any RNG tracker fork. If the default CUDA RNG state is asymmetric across TP ranks at the point of router construction, weights diverge.

cfg_invariant: After backward of linear_with_frozen_weight on TP=N, grad_input should equal sum across N ranks (i.e., expected = N * local_grad)
cfg_root_cause: LinearWithFrozenWeight.backward returns grad_input without all-reducing across TP ranks. Each rank only sees its column-shard of grad. linear_with_frozen_weight took async_grad_allreduce as dummy arg.

cfg_invariant: engine.communication_data_type() must be torch.bfloat16 when only bf16 is enabled
cfg_root_cause: DeepSpeedEngine.communication_data_type returned torch.float32 when bf16_enabled but no explicit comm dtype, so allreduce/reduce ran in fp32 silently breaking bf16 contract. Fix: return torch.bfloat16

cfg_invariant: InferenceEngine._create_ep_parallel_group must be called with ep_size, not num_experts
cfg_root_cause: InferenceEngine.__init__ called self._create_ep_parallel_group(config.moe.moe_experts); should be (config.moe.ep_size). When num_experts > ep_size the EP group has wrong size — when num_experts > worl

cfg_invariant: After clip_grad_norm_, ||grad|| must be <= max_norm (within tolerance)
cfg_root_cause: deepspeed/runtime/utils.py:clip_grad_norm_ used torch.max(1, max_norm/total_norm) so clip_coef=1 when grads exceed threshold (no clipping). Fix changes max -> min so clip_coef<=1 properly clips.

cfg_invariant: after AdamWConfig.build(model), every param_group must contain key 'initial_lr'
cfg_root_cause: build() returned torch.optim.AdamW without setting initial_lr. PyTorch LRScheduler with last_epoch>=0 requires initial_lr in each param_group; without it, peak LR after restart is lost.

cfg_invariant: expert_bias.dtype must be torch.float32 during routing. bf16/fp16 = bug.
cfg_root_cause: Float16Module converts all registered buffers to bf16/fp16. expert_bias is a fp32 buffer that gets silently downcast, causing precision loss in routing decisions.

cfg_invariant: actual total transformer layers across all PP ranks == configured num_layers
cfg_root_cause: Integer division (num_layers // pp_size) silently drops layers when not evenly divisible. No assertion existed outside the virtual pipeline block.

cfg_invariant: apply_input_jitter output dtype must equal input dtype. Dtype promotion from bf16 to fp32 = bug.
cfg_root_cause: torch.distributions.uniform.Uniform creates fp32 tensors by default (no dtype arg). Multiplying bf16 input by fp32 jitter silently promotes the result to fp32.

cfg_invariant: When dropout > 0, preserve_rng_state must be True
cfg_root_cause: Boolean condition inverted: preserve_rng_state = (all_dropout==0) instead of not(all_dropout==0)

cfg_invariant: After RMSNorm, output.pow(2).mean(-1) should be approximately 1.0
cfg_root_cause: x.norm(2) is L2 norm (sqrt(sum(x^2))), not RMS (sqrt(mean(x^2)))

cfg_invariant: optimizer state step must increment each training step
cfg_root_cause: step.add_(step_factor) was commented out in adamw_step

cfg_invariant: sqrt decay should decay fast initially, slow at end
cfg_root_cause: sqrt(progress) instead of 1-sqrt(1-progress) — wrong decay curve shape
